policies.title: PP 10998 full ordinary-visitor entry suspension
policies.summary: PP 10998 fully suspends the specified nationals' and Palestinian Authority document holders' ordinary visitor entry and visa issuance, subject to its express grandfathering and exceptions.
conditions: The suspension took effect at 12:01 a.m. EST on 2026-01-01 and applies only to people outside the United States then who lacked a valid visa; PP 10998 does not revoke earlier visas.
Categorical exceptions include lawful permanent residents, specified diplomatic or official visa holders, qualifying special immigrant visas, and certain major-sporting-event participants.
The immigrant-visa exception for ethnic and religious minorities facing persecution in Iran applies only to the Iran relationship.
A dual national is outside the restriction when travelling on a passport issued by a country not designated by PP 10998.
The Attorney General, Secretary of State, or Secretary of Homeland Security may grant an individual critical-national-interest or national-interest exception under the proclamation.
The proclamation does not limit asylum, refugee status, withholding of removal, or Convention Against Torture protection under United States law.
For PS, the full restriction attaches to travel on Palestinian Authority-issued or -endorsed travel documents, not nationality alone.

policies.title: PP 10998 partial B-1/B-2 visitor-entry suspension
policies.summary: PP 10998 suspends B-1, B-2, and B-1/B-2 visitor entry and visa issuance for the specified nationals, subject to its express grandfathering and exceptions.
conditions: For ordinary short visitors, the partial suspension covers B-1, B-2, and B-1/B-2 visas; it also covers F, M, J, and immigrant visas outside this visitor policy.
The suspension took effect at 12:01 a.m. EST on 2026-01-01 and applies only to people outside the United States then who lacked a valid visa; PP 10998 does not revoke earlier visas.
Categorical exceptions include lawful permanent residents, specified diplomatic or official visa holders, qualifying special immigrant visas, and certain major-sporting-event participants.
A dual national is outside the restriction when travelling on a passport issued by a country not designated by PP 10998.
The Attorney General, Secretary of State, or Secretary of Homeland Security may grant an individual critical-national-interest or national-interest exception under the proclamation.
The proclamation does not limit asylum, refugee status, withholding of removal, or Convention Against Torture protection under United States law.
